text:
Priya (PM): Quick design-check: the routing policy editor preview currently hides validation warnings until you run the simulation. Users in testing said they expect inline validation while editing (esp priority gaps). Thoughts on surface and copy?

Noah (Design): Agreed, inline is better. Maybe a small badge next to the rule stack that lists count of validation warnings, and a flyout explaining them. Badge label could be 'Warnings 2' but that feels terse. Options: 'Policy warnings (2)' or 'Check policy (2)'.

Jules (Frontend): Implementation-wise a badge is easy. The flyout should show short bullets and a CTA: "Auto-fix priorities" or "Open rule X". For empty priorities we can suggest: "Unordered rules detected 00000000" Hmm bad paste lol. Real copy: 'Unordered rules detected 000'

Kait (A11y): Small ask: the badge needs an accessible name like 'Policy warnings, 2'. Use aria-describedby to link to the flyout header. Also the flyout must trap focus while open and announce its content with role=dialog + aria-labelledby. For the 'Auto-fix' action, ensure confirmation dialog is accessible.

Noah (Design): For microcopy proposals:
- Badge: 'Policy checks (2)'.
- Flyout title: 'Policy validation'.
- Empty-priority warning line: 'Some rules have no priority 1 1\u2014 assign priorities or use Auto-arrange.'
- Auto-arrange tooltip: 'Automatically assign non-conflicting priorities based on rule creation time.'

Rory (Research): In last round people liked explicit remediation steps. 'Auto-arrange' is fine, but we should warn that it may change evaluation order. Proposed wording for confirmation modal: 'Auto-arrange will renumber rules to resolve conflicts. This may change which rule matches first. Proceed?' with primary 'Auto-arrange' and secondary 'Cancel'.

Jules (Frontend): Code sketch for announcing changes after auto-arrange:
```
// after auto-arrange completes
const msg = `Rules reordered. Rule ${movedId} is now ${newPos} of ${total}.`;
liveRegion.textContent = msg; // aria-live=polite
```
Make sure we internationalize the string.

Kait (A11y): Instead of a generic live region, use role=status or aria-live=polite on an offscreen area, and include IDs so screen readers focus to the changed rule when user chooses 'Open affected rule'. For drag reordering we should have keyboard controls and a confirmation announcement: 'Moved to position 2 of 5'.

Priya (PM): Good. One more UX edge: preview simulation currently shows a tiny heatmap + counts. Users want an at-a-glance reason when no output appears. Suggested empty-state inside preview: 'No matching traffic 1 Try enabling simulation, or broaden rule conditions.' Also show a 'Test with sample input' quick action.

Noah (Design): I like 'Test with sample input' as a CTA. Maybe small split control: 'Run sample' vs 'Run live simulation'. Copy:
- Button primary: 'Run sample input'
- Secondary: 'Run simulated traffic' (tooltip: 'Simulated results are ephemeral')

Jules (Frontend): I'll wire two buttons; sample will run faster client-side. Simulated traffic calls backend. Need to debounce the simulate button and show a cancel affordance. Also will add a small spinner and 'Simulation running 1 12s elapsed' text.

Kait (A11y): Spinner should include accessible label 'Simulation running, 12 seconds elapsed'. And ensure cancel button has aria-controls to clear the live region.

Rory (Research): In usability tests, participants wanted clearer error copy for circular priority problems. Proposed: 'Cannot simulate 1 Circular priority detected between rule A and rule B. Open diagnostics.' Link opens diagnostics panel.

Priya (PM): Ok action items: Noah will update Figma with badge + flyout patterns and the two-button CTA layout. Jules will prototype badge+flyout + aria-live region. Kait to draft a11y requirements for dialogs, drag reorder, and live announcements. Rory will write a couple test scripts for the next lab. I'll follow up on the modal copy for auto-arrange.

opsbot: preview-build available at https://preview.redwood.example/sim-editor-ux-219 :rocket:

Priya (PM): Thanks everyone. Posting the chosen microcopy here to lock it for dev:
- Badge: 'Policy checks (2)'.
- Flyout title: 'Policy validation'.
- Empty preview: 'No matching traffic 1 Try running sample input or adjust rule conditions.'
- Sim button primary: 'Run sample input' ; secondary: 'Run simulated traffic' (tooltip: 'Simulated results are temporary')
- Auto-arrange modal text: 'Auto-arrange will renumber rules to resolve conflicts. This may change which rule runs first. Proceed?'
